What's Changed
- Stabilize catalog E2E and Windows unit tests by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4413
- feat: create Supabase projects from an app's database connector by @RyanGroch in #4401
- feat(coolify): set up a Coolify server over SSH by @RyanGroch in #4326
- Label Auto Sidekick as experimental by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4447
- Collapse code panel folders by default by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4457
- Surface actionable Implementer subagent failures by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4448
- Preserve runtime logs across app restarts by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4446

- Surface commit errors in commit dialogs by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4462
- Add actionable diagnostics for bundled Git launch failures by @wwwillchen in #4411
- Bump to v1.14.0-beta.1 by @wwwillchen in #4464

- Dismiss GitHub push success message after five seconds by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4465
- Restore Supabase as default integration provider by @wwwillchen in #4474
- Clear worker caches for repeated preview auth failures by @wwwillchen in #4475
- Prevent stale Neon cookies from breaking preview auth by @wwwillchen in #4476
- Fix CI races in editor, queue, and firewall tests by @keppo-bot[bot] in #4469
